KISWAHILI — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #17
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: KISWAHILI
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

----

   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Kuandika 1.3.1 Insha ya Wasifu.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Kuandika 1.3.1 Insha ya Wasifu.
